Any other transfers from the government or Provincial Council other than capital funds not referred to in section

The  government's  transfers  to  capital  expenditures  are  primarily  identified  in  other  comprehensive  income.
Similarly, the equivalent value is deducted from other comprehensive income in the period in which it has met
the  revenue recognition  criteria identified  in  the  preceding paragraphs,  which are recognized as  the recognized
income of other comprehensive income. Assets and liabilities shall be recognized in the Statement of Assets and
Liabilities  as  a  separate  component  of  the  equity  of  the  government  transfers  that  does  not  satisfy  the  revenue
recognition criteria set forth in the preceding paragraphs of the reporting date.
